name: Crystal Facets
description: Faceted crystal with per-facet normals, total internal reflection past the critical angle (which is what makes real gem facets flash rather than merely darken), and uniaxial birefringence splitting ordinary and extraordinary rays along a per-facet optic axis with FFT-banded retardation. Adds the dataTextureA writeback and dataTextureC read-back the shader was missing, plus bounded click fracture fronts and ACES.
